claims.explanation: Buphenine is a beta-adrenergic agonist whose anticancer selectivity likely depends on ADRB2-mediated signaling, which can promote survival/proliferation in some lineages but also create dependency; the transcriptional response (HMOX1, CBR1, PPARG up) suggests NRF2/oxidative-stress and PPAR-related metabolic modulation. Lines with high ADRB2 expression and intact adrenergic/cAMP signaling would be sensitized, while those with low ADRB2 or high efflux/detoxification capacity would be protected. The observed similarity to PPAR agonists and histamine/chloride-channel drugs points to a broader metabolic/oxidative-stress mechanism rather than a single lineage.
